$comment: Blizzard Blitz cascade slot on ape.church. Native-APE game — wagers arrive as msg.value; fees/payouts go out as internal transactions. Contract is unverified so no ABI; we classify by counterparty, not by event.
$discover_labels: It will print every internal transaction from the game contract and tell you which counterparties are still UNLABELED.
Paste each address into the 'labels' dict below with a category: 'protocol_fee' | 'partner_fee' | 'house' | 'jackpot_pool' | 'referral' | or a custom name.
Hint from the reference tx: one address starts with 0x20852d and ends in 697da5f51 (takes ~89% of the 5% fee); another starts with 0x258f9Ead and ends in d36f98563 (takes ~10%).
name: blizzard_blitz
